purpose: Reuse successful OCR for identical document bytes and engine/preprocessing configuration without submitting duplicate pages to Hot Folder or calling Gemini again.

identity.input: SHA-256 of the actual engine input: preprocessed image/PDF for local OCR, original document selected by the Gemini adapter for consented fallback.

engines.fineReader: Selected period/image-or-PDF HFT recognition, preprocessing and output settings, embedded/referenced models, and OCR adapter implementation. Runtime task timestamps/status are excluded. Unknown configurations bypass reuse.
engines.tesseract: Executable, RTS_from_Cyrillic.traineddata and OCR adapter implementation.
engines.gemini: Configured model, thinking level and adapter implementation including transcription prompt. Explicit fallback consent remains required.

identity.engineUpgrade: After a FineReader application upgrade, increment OCR_CACHE_REVISION to invalidate prior results.

storage.renewal: A successful lookup renews expiration for seven days.
storage.text: Validated nonempty text only. Failed, timed-out, empty or mid-processing changed inputs/models are not cached.
storage.pdf: Independent immutable copies under backend/media/ocr/cache/<key>/<uuid>.pdf. Content hashes are checked at lookup. Missing/changed artifacts cause a fresh execution.
storage.cleanup: Unexpired cache PDFs and results referenced by live jobs are protected. Expired generated media is eligible for the existing reversible archive, never permanent deletion.
storage.oldResults: No import based on old TXT filenames: cache is populated by newly verified successful executions.

routing.cacheMiss: Only the OCR worker copies a complete input to its period inbox, with a fresh ocr_<uuid> name. Existing same-name TXT outputs cannot satisfy that execution.
routing.cacheHit: No watched-inbox write. All-cached step-3 submissions return status done immediately; mixed or queued jobs reuse results per file in the single durable worker.
routing.legacyDesktopLimit: Files manually placed into the legacy watched media/out desktop ScanTailor folder can still trigger Hot Folder independently of the web cache.

interface.cachedFiles: Response count remains internal; the result-reused notice is hidden in step 3.
interface.cachedResultLoading: Successful cached results show Se încarcă textul... for at least five seconds from request start. Time already spent waiting counts toward this minimum; leaving the step cancels the wait. Errors and fresh OCR results have no artificial delay.
interface.forceOcr: Refă OCR, fără a reutiliza rezultatul salvat. Forces a fresh execution and replaces the cache entry only after success.
interface.digi: Simple Digi jobs use the same OCR cache; transliteration runs on the returned text with current dictionaries.

environment.OCR_CACHE_REVISION: ocr-cache-v1 by default; change to invalidate existing entries
environment.FINEREADER_HOTFOLDER_CONFIG_DIR: Defaults to the Windows user's ABBYY/FineReader/15/HotFolder directory

presentationUpdate20261125.frontendChecks: 12 OCR result, polling and timer tests passed

deployment.backend: Restarted only after active user jobs completed; Hot Folder and AnyDesk left running.
deployment.frontend: Public bundle hash equals the local npm build.
deployment.rollback: Restore the backed-up frontend and previous application code, then restart backend/worker. The additive cache table can remain; no database restore or deletion is needed.
